name: Uniparts India Limited
summary: Uniparts India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies engineering systems, solutions, and assemblies primarily for off-highway vehicles in India, the United States, the Asia Pacific, Europe, Japan, and internationally. The company offers 3-point linkage systems, including rear and front hitch; precision machined parts, such as pins, brushes, and others; and fabrication products comprising frame coupler, trailer hitch and drawbars, and other applications, as well as power take-off products and hydraulic cylinders.
